title: The Dogon's knowledge of the Sirius binary star system

tellings.quote: And they they somehow, you know, in their tradition knew that there were two Sirius planets, Sirius A and Sirius B.

plain: The Dogon, a people of Mali in West Africa, are said to have known in their own tradition that Sirius, the brightest star in the night sky, is really two bodies, Sirius A and a hidden companion, Sirius B. Michels tells this himself, drawing on The Sirius Mystery, a book by the writer Robert Temple, saying they "somehow, you know, in their tradition knew" about the pair. If true, it would mean the Dogon had knowledge of the sky that they could not have gained with the naked eye.
